changeSet.author: OGC
changeSet.comment: Enable pg_trgm and fuzzystrmatch for patient search
changeSet.sql: create extension if not exists pg_trgm;
create extension if not exists fuzzystrmatch;

changeSet.author: OGC
changeSet.comment: Trigram indexes backing the patient search predicates
changeSet.sql: create index if not exists idx_person_last_name_trgm on clinlims.person using gin (lower(last_name) gin_trgm_ops);
create index if not exists idx_person_first_name_trgm on clinlims.person using gin (lower(first_name) gin_trgm_ops);
create index if not exists idx_patient_national_id_trgm on clinlims.patient using gin (lower(national_id) gin_trgm_ops);
create index if not exists idx_patient_external_id_trgm on clinlims.patient using gin (lower(external_id) gin_trgm_ops);
create index if not exists idx_patient_identity_data_trgm on clinlims.patient_identity using gin (lower(identity_data) gin_trgm_ops);
